scope: Diagnostic recommendation only from AA prospective plan, closed M1/M2/M3 self inspections/selections and four allowed existing initial views. Not a quality judgment or condition to close R23.

findings.evidence: Plan body_line_groups were separate metadata while native printed body was one unbroken literal paragraph. M2 initial became two long lines; M1 retained four lines but small actual body.
findings.inference: Comfortable body language and a stated line count do not concretely transmit sentence footprint.

findings.evidence: Scene/material descriptions precede detailed flat-plane or line-density decisions in native briefs; the common material sentence reinforces stone/glass/metal/light. M2 initial is textured pavement; M3 maker records photographic gloss and granular detail.
findings.inference: Physical material defaults can replace the intended image-expression grammar; prompt ordering is a plausible contributor, not an isolated causal proof.

minimal_method_recommendation: Lead the concise native brief with concrete image-expression rules and the actual copy shape. Put selected soft line groups in the sole printed-copy block without repeating whole copy. Resolve actual comfortable body footprint with Title and image before the first call; selectively use an existing-runtime newly authored whole-copy/image sketch when materially useful.
preserved_scope: Built-in imagegen final full-poster architecture; no code raster edits/overlays; actual copy roles only; shared good layouts; no mandatory five media/fonts/layouts or complex guides for every simple-copy request.
